official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL) — verified from the register, not from marketing. The page itself deep-links the RUCT detail record for code 3500166, and RUCT returns «Máster Universitario en People Analytics y Gestión de Talento Digital por la Universidad Camilo José Cela», nivel académico «Máster - RD 822/2021 (3)», estado «Publicado en B.O.E.». Quality report by Fundación para el Conocimiento madri+d (the Madrid regional agency, which under RD 822/2021 may evaluate in ANECA's place — «no ANECA report» is not evidence against officiality).
boe_order: Fecha de verificación 11/03/2024; autorización del Consejo de Ministros 17/09/2024; publicación del Acuerdo de Consejo de Ministros en el BOE 27/09/2024; publicación del plan de estudios en el BOE 21/02/2025. Autorización de la Comunidad de Madrid 13/08/2024. Curso de inicio de impartición 2024/2025.
europe_recognition: EHEA level 7 (Bologna) — academic recognition across the EHEA, and here the legal basis is fully documented: RUCT 3500166, MECES level 3, nivel académico «Máster - RD 822/2021 (3)», plan de estudios published in the BOE 21/02/2025. As an official Spanish Máster Universitario it is a second-cycle Bologna qualification, carries a Diploma Supplement as of right and gives access to doctoral study. WHERE THE PAGE OVERSTATES IT: ID Digital School writes that the title «cuenta con plena validez internacional» and «es reconocido en 49 países». That is a marketing gloss on EHEA membership, not a legal fact — what EHEA membership actually delivers is (a) that the qualification is read as a second-cycle degree in the other EHEA countries and (b) that recognition procedures there are streamlined under the Lisbon Recognition Convention. It is NOT automatic: the receiving country's own competent authority or university still runs its own recognition procedure. And it says nothing at all about PROFESSIONAL recognition for a regulated profession, which runs separately through Directive 2005/36/EC.
tuition_eu_eur: EUR 3,300 for the A DISTANCIA modality (the February cohort) and EUR 5,900 for the PRESENCIAL modality — full programme totals, published as flat prices, not per credit.
tuition_non_eu_eur: NOT FOUND as a distinct rate. The page publishes exactly one price per modality with no nationality qualifier anywhere: there is no non-EU, non-resident or international row. UCJC is a private university and private universities in Spain normally charge one flat rate irrespective of nationality — which for this non-EU candidate is a genuine positive finding, because there is no public-university-style doubling to absorb. But the page does not state that nationality is irrelevant, so per the brief this is recorded as NOT FOUND rather than as «no surcharge», and a human should confirm with admissions.
tuition_year_of_rates: Not labelled with a rate year on the page. The prices are displayed against the «próxima convocatoria» of octubre 2026 (presencial) and febrero 2027 (a distancia), i.e. they are the 2026-27 rates as published on 2026-08-29.
fees_extra_eur: EUR 225 «apertura de expediente» for the presencial modality; EUR 125 «apertura de expediente» for a distancia. Plus a EUR 600 «reserva de plaza» payable within 5 working days of admission — this is DEDUCTED from the total tuition, not additional, and is refundable only if the student fails the legal access requirements. So the realistic all-in for the February a distancia cohort is 3,300 + 125 = EUR 3,425.
modality: Two modalities offered: «Presencial» (Campus Castellana, Madrid) and «A distancia». The February intake is the A DISTANCIA one.
language_of_instruction: NOT FOUND — the page carries no «idioma de impartición» statement. The entire page, syllabus and module descriptions are in Spanish and there is no English-language version of the programme, but per rule 7 this is recorded as NOT FOUND rather than inferred.
start_month: February (a distancia) — «Próxima convocatoria: febrero 2027» is printed against the A distancia price. The presencial cohort starts «octubre 2026». Both dates are as published on 2026-08-29.
notes: 60 ECTS (RUCT breakdown: 40 obligatorios + 0 optativos + 8 prácticas externas + 12 TFM). RUCT «Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos: 0» — no bridging credits are built into the title; UCJC can still impose complementos on an individual applicant at admission, and the page notes that applicants who studied abroad must contact the programme coordination for the document list, so an individual ruling is likely. ADMISSION FILE (relevant, it is heavier than most): degree certificate, certified transcript, passport copy, CV with photo, TWO letters of recommendation, a motivation letter answering «¿Por qué has elegido la UCJC?», and the application template — all as PDFs to alejandra@iddigitalschool.com. Conditional enrolment is available for applicants about to graduate. RUCT CODE CONFIRMATION: the input hint 3500166 is correct and was confirmed twice — the programme page itself deep-links the RUCT detail URL carrying that code, and a direct RUCT query for «people analytics» returns exactly one row, this title. This is the programme the shared brief flags as absent from the pre-built backbone (no query term matches «people analytics» or «talento»), and indeed it is not in output/ruct-backbone.jsonl — absence there is not a verdict, and the direct query settles it. A NEW title: first taught 2024/2025, so it has been through verification but not yet a renewal of accreditation.

institution: UCJC — Universidad Camilo José Cela (programme delivered with ISEMCO, International School of Event Management & Communication)
programme_name: Máster Universitario en Dirección de Protocolo, Producción, Organización y Diseño de Eventos
city: Madrid (presencial/semipresencial) — ONLINE for the «a distancia» February cohort
campus: UCJC's own page names the campus as «Castellana - Facultad de Comunicación y Diseño», Madrid; RUCT confirms the teaching centre as UCJC's Facultad de Comunicación y Diseño (centre code 28051748). ISEMCO, the collaborating school, has its own Madrid site at C/ Diego de León 47, 28043 Madrid, and ISEMCO's page also mentions «campus Madrid y Asturias» for its wider portfolio — but the OFFICIAL UCJC master is taught at Campus Castellana or online, and the Asturias/Extremadura offerings on the same site are separate, non-official ISEMCO/other-university titles.
university_awarding: Universidad Camilo José Cela (UCJC). The diploma reads «Máster Universitario en Dirección de Protocolo, Producción, Organización y Diseño de Eventos por la Universidad Camilo José Cela». ISEMCO is a collaborating school (it «garantiza las prácticas»), not the awarding body and not a university.
institution_type: private university (UCJC, Comunidad de Madrid). ISEMCO is a private school (not a university).
official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL) — RUCT 4312968, estado «Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA)», nivel académico «Máster - RD 1393/2007 (1)». UCJC's own page confirms it is an official master and states the access rules for official master's studies verbatim from RD 1393/2007.
boe_order: Fecha de verificación 26/07/2011; BOE publication dates 07/01/2012, 01/03/2012 and 29/07/2013. Renovación de la acreditación: resolución favorable 23/02/2018 and again 21/10/2024 — the accreditation is current, which matters more than the 2011 verification date.
europe_recognition: EHEA level 7 (Bologna) — academic recognition across the EHEA. Legal basis: RUCT 4312968, MECES level 3, published in the BOE, accreditation renewed 21/10/2024. As an official Spanish Máster Universitario it is a second-cycle Bologna qualification, carries a Diploma Supplement as of right and gives access to doctoral study — the programme page states this directly («te permite acceder a los estudios de doctorado»), and here that claim is legally correct rather than marketing. The two standard limits still apply: it is academic, not professional, recognition (a regulated profession runs through Directive 2005/36/EC), and recognition in another EHEA state still goes through that state's own procedure — routine under the Lisbon Recognition Convention, but not automatic. NOTE ON THE SURROUNDING CATALOGUE: ISEMCO sells this official UCJC master on the same site as several similarly named non-official products — «Máster de Formación Permanente en Protocolo, Organización y Producción de Eventos», «Máster en Dirección y Producción de Eventos, Comunicación Corporativa y Protocolo», an MBA, and a «Máster Universitario en Dirección de Eventos y Protocolo» awarded by a DIFFERENT university (Universidad del Atlántico Medio, RUCT 4317071). Only the UCJC title under RUCT 4312968 is the one described here; the «Formación Permanente» ones are títulos propios with none of the above.
tuition_eu_eur: EUR 5,430 total for the ONLINE / a distancia modality (reserva de plaza 750 + precio docencia 4,680 = precio máster 5,430) and EUR 7,620 total for the PRESENCIAL modality (reserva de plaza 1,500 + precio docencia 6,120 = precio máster 7,620). These are UCJC's own published price sheets; the reserva de plaza is part of the total, not on top of it.
tuition_non_eu_eur: NOT FOUND as a distinct rate. UCJC's price sheets publish one figure per modality with no nationality qualifier — no non-EU, non-resident or international row exists on either PDF. As a private university UCJC applies a flat rate in practice, which for this non-EU candidate is a real positive: unlike the public system (where non-EU rates commonly double), there is no nationality surcharge published here. But the sheets do not say nationality is irrelevant, so per the brief this is NOT FOUND rather than «no surcharge».
tuition_year_of_rates: 2025-26 — printed on both price sheets as «Precios 2025-26», document version «v.1 Abril 2025». These are therefore one cycle behind a February 2027 start and should be expected to rise.
fees_extra_eur: «Apertura de expediente»: EUR 225 presencial / EUR 125 online (UCJC's own students are exempt). EUR 40 non-refundable admission processing transfer payable to the university's account (CEU SEK S.A., Banco Santander) with the application file. Both price sheets state «Tasas de Secretaría y Seguros no incluidos» — secretarial fees and insurance are extra and are NOT quantified anywhere, so that component is NOT FOUND. A 2% discount applies if the whole programme is paid up front.
modality: Three modalities: presencial, semipresencial and a distancia. Places per intake: 60 presencial, 30 semipresencial, 60 a distancia in October plus 60 a distancia in February. Presencial classes run Mon–Thu 16:00–21:00; a distancia runs online Mon–Thu 19:00–20:30.
language_of_instruction: Español — stated explicitly on UCJC's own programme page in the header data block («Idioma: Español»). This is the official statement, not an inference from a translated page. There is no English-medium option. For a Spanish-A1 candidate this is a hard filter on a protocol-and-events degree whose subject matter is itself language- and register-intensive.
start_month: February — the a distancia modality runs a February cohort with 60 places («Modalidad A distancia: 60 por curso (octubre) y 60 por curso (febrero)») and UCJC publishes a separate «horario de clases - a Distancia, febrero». UCJC's header data block lists the headline «Inicio: Octubre», so February is the second, distance-only entry point. WARNING ON DATE STALENESS: ISEMCO's page still carries «Comienza el 14 de octubre de 2024 y finaliza en junio de 2025» — an un-updated 2024-25 calendar. No 2027 calendar is published; a human must confirm the exact February 2027 date.
notes: 60 ECTS (48 obligatorias + 6 prácticas externas + 6 TFM) — the programme page's own breakdown matches RUCT exactly, which is a good consistency check. RUCT «Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT» (null — the register does not print the row for this title; that is NOT the same as 0), so the applicant-level rule must come from UCJC. ACCESS FOR A NON-EEA DEGREE — this is the clearest statement in the batch and it is good news: UCJC quotes RD 1393/2007 verbatim, «podrán acceder los titulados conforme a sistemas educativos ajenos al Espacio Europeo de Educación Superior SIN NECESIDAD DE LA HOMOLOGACIÓN de sus títulos, previa comprobación por la Universidad de que aquellos acreditan un nivel de formación equivalente… El acceso por esta vía no implicará, en ningún caso, la homologación del título previo». So a Tunisian 5-year engineering degree can be admitted on an equivalence check by the university, with no homologación required — but that admission route confers nothing beyond admission. ISEMCO adds that non-EU applicants must present degree and transcript with the Hague apostille (EU applicants only need originals or notarised copies). ADMISSION FILE: application form, DNI/passport, certified transcript, degree certificate, CV, motivation letter, two recommendation letters, plus the EUR 40 transfer receipt. RUCT code 4312968 confirmed from the register row naming UCJC and the exact title; it matches the input hint and is also present in output/ruct-backbone.jsonl. Note that a differently named UNIR title, «Máster Universitario en Protocolo y Eventos» (RUCT 4317921), is a separate record in this same batch — RUCT contains ten «protocolo» masters and two of them are being wound down (UCAM 4312236 «A EXTINGUIR», UNED 4314568 «EXTINGUIDA»), so title similarity is not identity.
